rationale: No suitable optimization is supported for this workflow. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the workflow deploys Azure infrastructure (release/deployment work), and canceling in-progress runs risks orphaned resources since the cleanup job depends on test-e2e completing. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated because every matrix outcome (Linux/amd64 and Windows/amd64 build and test) provides unique, required coverage for this e2e test workflow. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already addressed by actions/setup-go@v6, which automatically caches the Go module cache based on go-version-file. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative per-job duration history to set safe limits without risking valid slow runs. Remaining patterns either do not apply to this Go-based Azure e2e workflow (Bazel patterns), operate at the CI service level rather than workflow level (P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST, P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY, P-LIT-ENV-CACHE, P-LIT-UNAFFECTED-STEPS, P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE, P-LIT-UNUSED-DEP-SKIP), or are contraindicated for a strict e2e test contract (P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW, P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER, P-LIT-SELECT).
